characters.carries: a waterproof abacus case strapped across her back with a cracked leather strap
characters.complication: she cannot stop auditing things that were never debts — meals, apologies, silences — and adds them all to the total
characters.look: A heavyset grey-brown dugong body with a broad fluked tail, small deep-set eyes, and a whiskered snout, dragon-scale plates riveted in an overlapping row down her spine like segmented armor, a cracked leather satchel strapped across her back leaking a thin stream of bubbles, front flippers oddly articulated with small metal rings threaded along the edges like tally beads.
characters.name: Portia Fivetooth
characters.role_drive: a debt collector reincarnated in dugong shape who insists every unpaid ledger on the ship still belongs to her, and hums with restless hyperactive energy while doing sums no one asked for

proposal.idea: On a generation ship gone frontier-lawless, a dugong-formed debt collector drifts the flooded cargo decks calling in debts owed to a dead economy, while something in the water keeps the books better than she does.

locations.art_direction: Waist-deep black water filling a corridor between rusted cargo containers, patches of overlapping dragon-scale plating welded crooked over hull cracks, a low ceiling strung with dead cables dripping condensation, single swinging lamp casting a moving disk of light on the water's surface.
locations.best_scene: a rowboat threading between upright shipping crates half-submerged, dragon-scale patches welded over hull breaches catching lamplight, a slow wake fanning out where something unseen has just passed beneath
locations.known_for: a sunken cargo level of a generation ship where old debt contracts float sealed in waterproof pouches, and something large and gentle patrols the wreckage collecting them
locations.local_rule: no debt may be called in until the bell above the waterline is rung three times by hand
locations.title: Ninth Ledger Flood Deck

rewards.best_used_when: smuggling a debt, a letter, or a secret through flooded or hostile territory
rewards.catch: it always drifts slowly toward whoever is owed something by its contents, regardless of your intentions
rewards.grants: a small chest that always floats upright and keeps whatever is sealed inside dry no matter how deep it sinks
rewards.look: A squat iron-bound chest the size of a footlocker, its wood blackened and swollen with old water damage, banded in corroded brass hoops, one corner patched with an overlapping plate of dragon scale gone dull silver-green, a thin rope of barnacles crusted along its waterline seam.
rewards.name: The Unsinkable Tally Chest

rewards.best_used_when: someone denies owing anything and the truth needs to be made visible without a word said
rewards.catch: the nanites cannot be told which debts matter, so old grudges and forgotten kindnesses surface with equal glowing insistence
rewards.grants: the ability to seed a swarm of debt-tracking nanites into any surface, causing faint glowing tally marks to surface on skin, metal, or stone wherever an unpaid obligation exists
rewards.look: A skin or surface suddenly stippled with faint blue-white filament lines that crawl like slow lightning beneath the top layer, converging into small glowing tally notches that pulse once and dim, leaving a temporary silvery residue like frost.
rewards.name: Ledger-Skin Recalibration

scenarios.setup: Under The Slow Bell of Ninth Ledger, deep in the Ninth Ledger Flood Deck, Portia Fivetooth rings the bulkhead bell for the third time in a single day — a violation of the local rule no one has committed in a generation — because the water itself has started keeping a ledger she did not write, and something beneath the surface is finally answering the call.
scenarios.title: Three Rings of the Bell

proposal.title: The Slow Bell of Ninth Ledger

vibe.art_direction: Wide flooded corridor of a generation ship lit by failing amber strip-lights reflected in still black water, dust motes hanging in stale recycled air, a brass bell bolted to a bulkhead green with verdigris, distant silhouette of a heavy round body gliding just beneath the surface.
vibe.line: Out past the last audited star, the only law left is compound interest.
vibe.title: The Slow Bell of Ninth Ledger
